overlicensed_spans: Every autonomous command was delivered to the base controller throughout the action interval.
rationale: The reported failure and timeout, planner failure observation, and exact sampled odometry distance with its frame/window and arrival limitation are supported and cover all required units. Command summaries and discrete runtime graph snapshots do not establish delivery of every autonomous command throughout the action interval; that claim extrapolates beyond observed controller evidence.
